# CNN From Scratch

> A convolutional neural network and its reverse-mode backpropagation, built from scratch in Python with every forward and backward pass written by hand and every gradient verified against finite differences.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch

## Source

- [src/cnn_from_scratch/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/__init__.py): CNN From Scratch - a convolutional neural network and its autodiff, from scratch.
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/cli.py): Command line interface for the convolutional network.
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/data.py): A deterministic synthetic image-classification task with spatial structure.
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/evaluation.py): Evaluation: accuracy, confusion matrix, and a linear baseline.
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/layers.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/layers.py): Neural network layers with explicit forward and backward passes.
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/model.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/model.py): A sequential container, a small convolutional network, and the loss.
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the trained convolutional classifier.
- [src/cnn_from_scratch/training.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/cnn-from-scratch/blob/main/src/cnn_from_scratch/training.py): Training the convolutional network with an Adam optimizer from scratch.
